name: Comfortable gaming headset with a clear microphone
summary: In team games, a headset does two jobs: it lets you hear footsteps and positioning cues, and it lets your team hear you clearly. Comfort over several hours matters more than extra features.
lookFor: Comfort: weight, clamping force, earpad material and breathability for long sessions
A stereo sound signature that is clear rather than boomy, since bass-heavy tuning can mask footsteps
A microphone that sounds clear in independent recordings, ideally detachable or retractable
Wired for simplicity, or wireless with a dongle that has low latency and battery life you can live with
Open-back designs sound spacious but leak sound; closed-back designs isolate better
suitableFor: Players in voice-chat team games and anyone who plays in a shared space and wants good positional hearing.
pros: Better positional audio than most speakers
cons: Comfort is very personal, and a bad fit ruins the headset
Virtual surround modes help some players and hurt others
